About this instrument & credits

A browser adaptation of LIRA•8 by Mike Moreno DSP, running the original Pure Data synthesis patch through libpd-wasm. Inspired by SOMA Laboratory’s LYRA-8; unofficial and unaffiliated. This is a digital interpretation, not a circuit-accurate hardware model. Presets change settings; touch a pad or raise Hold to hear them.
